item.description:
SleekDemo 2.10.0

Edit your video by its words, a liquid-glass loupe, automatic privacy, and a lot more control.

  • Edit by transcript: delete words to cut them from the video, and remove every "um" in one step.
  • Liquid-glass loupe: a frameless magnifier that bends the picture at its rim.
  • Automatic privacy: emails, numbers, keys and faces stay covered, found on your Mac.
  • Command Menu (⌘K), screenshots and Copy Frame (⇧⌘C).
  • Made For export presets, ProRes export and a file-size estimate.
  • Speed Up Typing, instant zooms, animated titles and shapes.
  • New cursor, camera, shadow and recording options, and smoother camera motion.

SleekDemo 2.9.0

A record shortcut, a cleaner desktop, smarter camera, and a loupe.

  • ⇧⌘2 starts or stops a recording from any app.
  • Clean desktop: desktop icons and widgets stay out of your recordings.
  • Exact window sizes before you record, and exports copied to your clipboard.
  • Keep Me Centred, Hide While I'm Not Talking, and camera looks.
  • Loupe: magnify one spot instead of zooming the whole screen.
  • Reel preview and a proper iPad frame.

SleekDemo 2.8.0

Hide what's private, even when you zoom in.

  • Blur that stays put: blur, mosaic and spotlight boxes now stick to your screen, so zooms and pans never reveal what they hide.
  • Blur button: hide an email, a key or a notification in one click from the timeline.
